scope: Whole UDP packet checksum7B1FD0/64DE80, response update48BA10 and zero-peer private send5414C0
assumptions: Explicit payload byte vectors are placed in packet+20, length at+10. Packet storage and bytes after each payload startA5; output is read at+1C. Empty input, all four byte remainders, high bits, carry and558-byte input are bounded numerical controls, not live UDP or reliability observations.
Only checksum storage may change. Full native return and, for nonempty input, execution of64DE80 are required. There is no Python checksum model.

Response controls supply CommBuffer sum/count/mean at+14/+18/+1C and one elapsed wall-clock value; original48BA10 produces all retained outputs. Samples255/256, remainder7F/80, unsigned high bits and wrapping sums are bounded arithmetic inputs. Diagnostic peak+20 is allowed to change but is outside the Rust response consumer; other storage must remain unchanged.

Private-send control supplies initialized flags+4/+5, peer count+44=0, zero payload length and destinationFFFFFFFF. Required instructions5414E1 and5415DF establish the early rejection; no connection callbacks run.
